summary: This research study is testing a medicine called NNC0487-0111 to see how it affects people with excess body weight and knee osteoarthritis, which is when the knee joint breaks down and causes pain. Participants are given either the study drug or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the medicine, injected under the skin once a week. The trial has a status of Active, not recruiting and is sponsored by Novo Nordisk A/S. It is a Phase 3 study with 388 participants.
